candidates.explanation: The patient harbors a PALB2 missense mutation (p.K486E) that impairs double-strand break repair via homologous recombination, suggesting sensitivity to PARP inhibition. Rucaparib is reported to target PALB2-mutated tumors with an evidence score of 0.358. Therefore, Rucaparib is a candidate treatment worth clinician review for this patient.

candidates.explanation: The patient harbors a PALB2 missense mutation (p.K486E) that is directly targeted by Talazoparib, supporting its consideration as a therapy. PALB2 participates in double-strand break repair via homologous recombination, so loss-of-function mutations may sensitize the tumor to PARP inhibition by Talazoparib. DGIdb links the PALB2 p.K486E mutation to Talazoparib with an evidence score of 0.357, providing moderate support for clinical benefit.
